title.narrative: Liberian Food Safety Initiative # Enhancing food safety practices and compliance across selected value chains

description.narrative: In response to the main challenges Liberia is facing in regard to food safety, the Liberian Food Safety Initiative (LiFSI) has been designed to boost trade in and safe consumption of locally produced food by enhancing food safety practices and compliance along selected value chains.The project holistically addresses this matter at macro, meso and micro level, with a clear demand-driven approach, that is focusing on sustainability and financial viability.
